$comment: Application configuration and safety controls. Seed for the Dataverse Configuration table. No environment-specific value (endpoint, tenant, mailbox) appears here - those are supplied by environment variables (NFR-021).

features.$comment: The system ships with every outbound capability DISABLED. Each flag is unblocked by closing the named gap - see docs/solution-design.md section 9.

shadowMode.description: Classify, decide, validate and audit, but suppress all mailbox side effects.

sendResponsesEnabled.unblockedBy: GAP-004 / Q-02, Q-03 - approved template wording

forwardingEnabled.unblockedBy: Owner addresses confirmed and pilot passed

deleteEnabled.unblockedBy: GAP-006 / Q-08 - delete semantics and retention policy

externalRecipientsEnabled.description: Allow outbound mail to senders outside the allow-listed domains.

attachmentContentHandlers.description: Download and process attachment content (e.g. screenshot OCR). Off means attachment content is never downloaded.

ownerResponseSuppressionEnabled.description: Stop BOT processing once a designated owner has responded on the thread (FR-011).

safety.$comment_botIdentities: GAP-013 - populate with the SPA shared mailbox UPN and any alias the automation sends from. Loop prevention degrades to header-based detection only while this is empty.
safety.$comment_allowedRecipientDomains: GAP-017. Outbound mail to any other domain is blocked and the item goes to human review.
safety.$comment_storeBodyPreview: AD-012 / NFR-007. Off means only a SHA-256 body hash is persisted, never the body text.

ownerResponseSuppression.$comment: GAP-015 / Q-10 - the BRD does not define the scope or duration. expiryHours null means suppression does not expire.

retry.$comment: NFR-001. Applied to every external dependency - see docs/integration-design.md section 9.

attachments.$comment: FR-080 to FR-083. Metadata is always captured. Content is only ever downloaded when features.attachmentContentHandlers is true AND a registered handler supports the MIME type.

ai.$comment: Model name, deployment and endpoint are supplied per environment. Values here are behavioural defaults only.

reporting.$comment: FR-090 to FR-098. GAP-014 / Q-12 - recipients, time and timezone are not defined in the BRD, so there is no default recipient. The flow logs and skips rather than guessing an address.

senderTypes.$comment: GAP-007 / Q-17 - the BRD references sender type for SC-12 template selection but never enumerates it. This seed is FOR REVIEW, not a confirmed business taxonomy.
